import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd

def task_func():
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase

    combinations = [''.join(chars) for chars in itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3)]
    df = pd.DataFrame({'combination': combinations})

    first_letters = pd.Series([combo[0] for combo in combinations])
    counts = first_letters.value_counts().reindex(list(alphabet), fill_value=0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(counts.index, counts.values)
    ax.set_xlabel('First letter')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
    ax.set_title('Frequency of First Letters in 3-Letter Combinations')

    return df, ax
